structural_change: S81-CTRL 10-17: NEW regional S81 HBM controller (p4g SPEC (3), p4i open master dsfd_ctrl_rg2 x16, 531.25 x 250 um on the PHY N face). 2 x the benched S81-PH per-PC channel ot_s81ph_ctrl_pc (unchanged) + one regional status register; regional reset leaf synchronised per domain; PHY face = the PHY's k_*/kr_* buses for PCs 2k,2k+1 (S), svc slice rq 682 / rd 562 (N). Flow control only at the HBM boundary (PHY valid/ready); die face never stalls (overflow = sticky fault). Bench: tb_dsfd_ctrl on 16 x rg2 PASS (same latencies as dsfd_ctrl: rq->PHY min 6.95 cks, PHY->rd 5.26 cks), mutants MUT_RD / MUT_PACK FAIL. ck_o = rd-link forwarded clock (clk through the kept ckinv pair, as the dvrly stations), N face. Pin plan (tools/s81_ctrl/gen_rg2_bench.py pins): S face = PC 0 bits W half / PC 1 E half in the PHY's x order (abuts the PHY DFI columns), ckh at the S centre; N face = PC 0 rq+rd W half, clk + ck_o centre, PC 1 E half.
